summary: Reviewed all source/schema/docs/version changes. Explicit lifecycle settings are separate from runtime pins; quiescent adoption journals exact bytes and modes, blocks incomplete migration, preserves history and overrides, and refuses rollback after task inventory drift. Named profiles cannot silently change existing task policy. All intake routes and configured scaffolds preserve profiles and pending requirements. Review bundles retain full task/project provenance but are not executable transfer. Stale stack update apply/rollback cannot erase later settings. Regressions exercise crash/resume/rollback, malformed input, schema parity, actual recommendation promotion and complete publication/deployment settings without effect authority. All 368 Linux tests, ordinary macOS/Linux make and candidate distribution checks passed.
